# CodeMirror 5.65.21

The playground's code editor. These are files from the npm package `codemirror@5.65.21`
(https://codemirror.net/5/), unmodified: `lib/codemirror.js` and `.css`, `mode/lua/lua.js`,
`addon/edit/matchbrackets.js`, `addon/hint/show-hint.js` and `.css`, `addon/search/search.js` and
`searchcursor.js`, and `addon/dialog/dialog.js` and `.css`. The tarball's sha512 matched
the registry's.

They're kept here, like ESP Web Tools, because the page runs only scripts from this repository.

To update: `npm pack codemirror@VERSION`, check its sha512 against
`npm view codemirror@VERSION dist.integrity`, copy the same files over, and change the version here
and in `NOTICE`.
